description: Three-phase multifunction energy meter with LCD and RS485 Modbus

sources.title: MMS-03 Modbus Registers
sources.note: Spreadsheet supplied with the map request

notes: Addresses are those in the spreadsheet, used as they are (address_base 0). Input registers are read with function 0x04. All values are big endian.
Energies are 64-bit integers in micro-units (µWh, µvarh, µVAh); the scale converts them to Wh, varh and VAh.
The spreadsheet gives the hour timers at 53 and 55 as '33 bit' and '34 bit' unsigned; they are taken as 32-bit like the first one at 51.
The spreadsheet gives no serial settings (baud rate, parity, stop bits) or unit id, so none are set here.

The THD values are sent as the actual value divided by 100 (a ratio), so the scale of 100 gives percent. The individual harmonics 2 to 31 are sent as the actual value multiplied by 100, so the scale of 0.01 gives percent.
Register 4000 is write-only: the spreadsheet says to send 'T' for relay on and 'F' for relay off.
